evidence_method: An official U.S. Supreme Court docket reproducing the federal criminal indictment records that Marketwired uploaded the PNRA press release at approximately 9:04 AM ET on October 22, 2013 and issued it to the public later that day at approximately 4:05 PM ET. SEC Exhibit 99.1 independently corroborates Panera Bread Company, the October 22, 2013 Q3 2013 release title/date, reporting period and release content. The approximate-minute qualifier is preserved verbatim; no EDGAR, conference-call, archive-capture, scheduled or inferred timestamp is substituted.
